descriptions.inProgress: #b#p2071000##k, the landlord of the Korean Folk Town, is concerned that the residents of the Folk Town is rapidly getting sick these days because of a bunch of #r#o5100004#s#k from the Black Mountain that put curse on any person that crosses their path. In order to end the curse that is affecting the town, he said it requires #b999 foxtails#k, and since each #t4000172# has #b3 tails#k, I need to get #b333 #t4000172#s#k for him. \n\n#t4000172#  #b#c4000172##k / 333
descriptions.completed: To cure the curse of the Three-Tailed Fox that is affecting the residents in Folk Town, I gathered up 333 #t4000172#s like Chumji asked. Chumji thanked me for my work, and gave me an all-purpose medicine.
